literal.prompt: Как называется сборник решений церковного собора 1551 года?

finalGroupBindings.primaryGround: The exact prompt/key claim is directly supported by the retained President Library L48: it names the 1551 Stoglav council and says its decisions were published as Stoglav. Each distractor is a different historical document: L46 identifies Russkaya Pravda as an early Russian-law monument; L58 identifies the 1497 Sudebnik as a unified legislative code; L54 describes Anna tearing up the Conditions after the Supreme Privy Council sought to limit her authority. Only Stoglav is the 1551 church-council collection.
finalGroupBindings.locator: President Library L48; President Library L46; President Library L58; President Library L54.

finalGroupBindings.literal: Правильный ответ — Стоглав: так называется сборник решений собора, созванного в 1551 году при Иване IV. Его постановления касались церковной жизни и религиозных обрядов.
finalGroupBindings.primaryGround: President Library L48 explicitly names the 1551 Stoglav council, the collection of its decisions, and that they concerned regulation of church life and religious rites.

finalGroupBindings.literal: Решения Стоглава регулировали церковную жизнь и религиозные обряды.
finalGroupBindings.primaryGround: The additional fact is that the decisions in Stoglav concerned regulation of church life and religious rites; it is beyond the prompt and answer label.

finalGroupBindings.literal: Русская Правда — древнерусский свод правовых норм.
finalGroupBindings.primaryGround: President Library L46 calls Russkaya Pravda an early monument of Russian law created in Yaroslav the Wise’s era, supporting its description as an early Russian legal code.

finalGroupBindings.literal: Судебник 1497 года унифицировал нормы права Московского государства.
finalGroupBindings.primaryGround: President Library L58 states that the 1497 Sudebnik was a unified legislative code introduced in September 1497, supporting the note that it unified Moscow-state law.

finalGroupBindings.literal: «Кондиции» 1730 года пытались ограничить власть Анны Иоанновны.
finalGroupBindings.primaryGround: President Library L54 states that Anna Ioannovna publicly tore up the Conditions after the Supreme Privy Council attempted to limit her authority.
finalGroupBindings.locator: President Library L52-L54: L52 dates Anna Ioannovna’s accession in 1730; L54 describes the Conditions and the attempt to limit her authority.
